blocks.text: Computational problems ko un ki khasusiyat aur unhein hal karne ke tareeqon ki bunyad par mukhtalif qismon (categories) mein baanta ja sakta hai. Kuch aam qismein yeh hain:

items: Decision Problems: aise masail jin ka output sirf “haan” ya “nahi” hota hai. Misal: kya yeh adad juft (even) hai?
Search Problems: aise masail jin mein koi hal ya cheez dhoondni hoti hai jo kuch sharait (criteria) poori kare. Misal: kya Islamabad shehron ki is list mein hai?
Optimization Problems: aise masail jin mein kisi miyar (criteria) ke mutabiq sab se behtar hal dhoondna hota hai. Misal: tamam shehron se guzarne wala sab se chhota raasta.
Counting Problems: aise masail jin mein ginna hota hai ke kuch sharait kitne tareeqon se poori ho sakti hain. Misal: tamam shehron se guzarne wale kitne raaste hain?

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Upar har qism ke saath di gayi misal hamari taraf se hai, kitab se nahi; yeh sirf farq samjhane ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt: Optimization problems ki nauiyat (nature) par baat kijiye aur asal zindagi ki misalein dijiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Optimization masle ke kai durust hal hote hain, aur woh kisi paimane par sab se behtar hal maangta hai, jaise kam se kam kharcha, sab se chhota faasla ya sab se zyada qeemat, aksar kuch pabandiyon (constraints) ke saath. Misalein (is chapter se): sab se chhota delivery raasta (Travelling Salesman Problem), wazan ki had ke andar sab se qeemti saaman (Knapsack Problem), aur kam se kam sikkon mein raqam banana (Coin Change). Aise bohat se masail mushkil hote hain, is liye greedy tareeqe ya dynamic programming istemal hoti hai.

items: Masail ki qismein: decision (haan/nahi), search (dhoondna), optimization (sab se behtar), counting (kitne tareeqe).
